statement: The first group_a_size agents are assigned GROUP_A.
Agents after group_a_size are assigned GROUP_B.
mod1 matches Julia wrap (e.g. mod1(4,3)=1, mod1(3,3)=3).
OnePair always matches two distinct agents when n≥2.
Returned indices lie in 1:n for valid random inputs.
Equal-length count vectors never throw on a square payoff matrix.
Length-3 counts on a 3×3 matrix succeed when dimensions match size(U,1).
Zero count totals yield advantage :unknown and NaN payoffs.
run_simulation does not alter the task-local RNG stream after return.
Recorded strategies always belong to playable_A/playable_B.
Common memory is not read when choosing a strategy.
group_a_size equals min(round(Int,n*ratio), n÷2) for documented inputs.
